instruction: Load the page https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/searching in your browser and extract the design recommendations section. Create a document titled "design_recommendations.docx" and save it to the desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Apple HIG and saving design recommendations. Evaluator checks for minimum content and relevant keywords. Similar to original in web navigation and content extraction workflow.

llm_judge_reasons: Minimum content length (45 characters) is far too low to verify meaningful extraction of design recommendations from Apple HIG page
Keywords 'design' and 'search' are extremely generic and would match almost any tangentially related content, not specifically Apple HIG design recommendations
No verification that content actually comes from the specified Apple HIG page or contains actual design recommendations
With only 2 generic keywords and partial_keyword_match=true, evaluator is too lenient and could pass with unrelated content
Evaluator cannot distinguish between correctly extracted design recommendations vs. any document containing 'design' and 'search' words
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Increase min_content_length to at least 200-300 characters to ensure substantial content extraction
Add more specific keywords from Apple HIG design recommendations (e.g., 'guidelines', 'interface', 'user experience', 'accessibility', 'navigation')
Consider adding domain-specific keywords that would only appear in Apple HIG content (e.g., 'iOS', 'macOS', 'human interface')
Increase keyword count to 4-6 keywords to better verify content relevance
Consider switching to exact keyword matching (partial_keyword_match=false) or increasing the required keyword match threshold
